routes.name: R_INDEPENDENT_SUPPORT
routes.retired_because: Independently sampled supports have the wrong quantifier order; color-only type discrepancy is uniform over all subsequently chosen state data.

C9000330.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 330 (A uniformly discrete counterexample to bounded approximation in Lipschitz-free spaces.; papers: A uniformly discrete counterexample to bounded approximation in Lipschitz-free spaces; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/330.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_SIGNED_CONTINUATION.statement: Actual finite matched-walk records imply opposing Lipschitz scalar tests and Lambda >= 2*a0 - 4*L*V*(1/Delta + beta) for arbitrary signed coefficients.

C_CONTINUATION_RECORDS.statement: Absence of a length-n matched walk bounds actual continuation records and forces an exceptional direction at one end of every compatible nearby state transition.

C_OPPOSING_TESTS.statement: Bump activation and the derived exceptional-direction property give consistent opposing Lipschitz prescriptions, extendible with range [-L,L].

C_SIGNED_AVERAGING.statement: Signed variation controls each exceptional-state loss; regular incidence averaging and reversal give the stated uniform obstruction.

C_LOCAL_LIMIT.statement: The deterministic colored regular multigraph sequence has the stated induced rooted colored tree limit (lem:local-limit).
C_LOCAL_LIMIT.proof_kind: self-contained permutation-exploration and exact deterministic-selection proof

C_PERM_EXPLORATION.statement: One- and two-root induced permutation explorations have collision probability at most c_r^2/(N-c_r), and squared type-frequency error at most 1/N+3 c_r^2/(N-c_r).

C_ADAPTIVE_TRANSFER.statement: Every finite state system simultaneously satisfies beta_m(S,n) <= epsilon_m,n + |S|(H/k)(Delta Q H/k)^n; local convergence and k>2 Delta Q H give n>=2 followed by arbitrarily large graph indices.

C_BLOCK_GEOMETRY.statement: The anchor metric, label map, small-ball and coordinate bounds satisfy lem:block-geometry.

C_FINITE_SUPPORT.statement: Finite-rank anchor approximation admits the common finite-support perturbation of lem:finite-support.

C_MEASURE_BOUNDS.statement: The affine signed measures obey the total-variation and bump-integral bounds of lem:measure-bounds.

C_RARE_WALKS.statement: For each already fixed operator-dependent support, successive choices of n and m give beta < 1/(20V), as in lem:rare-walks.
C_RARE_WALKS.independent_review: pending for the probabilistic component; block geometry remains separately open

C_BLOCKS.statement: For each p >= 1 the fixed finite anchor set defeats all finite-rank operators of norm at most p (thm:blocks).

C_COEFFICIENTS.statement: The bounded separated block coefficient isomorphism obeys the stated l1 bounds and gives 2B-BAP (prop:coefficients).

C_WEDGE.statement: The metric wedge preserves the block obstructions and has AP from its finite-block retractions and coefficient approximations.

C_MAIN.statement: The manuscript's countable uniformly discrete unbounded nonproper space has AP and fails every finite BAP bound (thm:main).
